title: Cech augmentation compatibility for a prescribed target global class
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $\iota$ a finite index type, and $U_i\subset X,V_i\subset Y$ open families such that $\bigcap_l V_{y(l)}\subset g^{-1}(\bigcap_l U_{y(l)})$ for every tuple. Let $I,J$ be injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the lifted additive structure sheaves [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], with canonical comparisons $c_X,c_Y$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. Write $G_I,G_J$ for their global section complexes and $T_U,T_V$ for their Cech total complexes, with augmentations $\alpha_U,\beta_U,\alpha_V,\beta_V$ [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization]. Fix $n\ge0$, coefficient Cech cycles $z,z\prime$ [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change] such that every coordinate of $z\prime$ is the structural pullback of the corresponding coordinate of $z$, restricted along the tuple inclusion. Suppose $s\in Z^n(G_I)$ and $t_\alpha,t_\beta\in Z^n(T_U)$ satisfy $i(t_\alpha)=\alpha_U(i(s))$, $i(t_\beta)=\beta_U(i(z))$, and $[t_\alpha]=[t_\beta]$. Let $s\prime\in Z^n(G_J)$ be supplied and assume $c_Y([s\prime])=H^n(q_g)(\operatorname{cohomologyMap}(g)(c_X([s])))$, where $q_g$ is the adjoint of the structural additive coefficient map [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image,def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Then there exist $t\prime_\alpha,t\prime_\beta\in Z^n(T_V)$ with $i(t\prime_\alpha)=\alpha_V(i(s\prime))$, $i(t\prime_\beta)=\beta_V(i(z\prime))$, and $[t\prime_\alpha]=[t\prime_\beta]$. No covering hypothesis or edge equivalence is assumed. The global cycle and its class equation are hypotheses, not conclusions.

source.place: Lemma 20.15.1, explicit augmented double-complex maps (without inverting alpha); Tag 01FB resolution comparisons; Tag 03P2 coefficient sections.

proof.text: Use the pullback chain-transfer theorem to obtain f,t and the alpha and beta equations and the canonical global-class formula. Map t_alpha,t_beta by cyclesMap(t); cyclesMap_i and the augmentation equations identify their inclusions, while homology projection naturality transports their equal classes.

Take the cochain map a given by the alpha-map theorem. The supplied hclass and the canonical global-class formula, after injectivity of cY.globalEquiv, show that s_prime and cyclesMap(f)(s) have equal global homology classes. Apply homologyMap(a). Injectivity of total iCycles identifies cyclesMap(a)(cyclesMap(f)(s)) with cyclesMap(t)(t_alpha). Therefore cyclesMap(a)(s_prime) and cyclesMap(t)(t_beta) have equal total classes, and their inclusions are the required alpha and beta values. This is a homology argument, without choosing a boundary representative or inverting either augmentation.

proof_origin.place: Explicit pullback chain-transfer and alpha cochain maps; homology naturality and injectivity of the supplied canonical comparison replace the prescribed global representative.

from.place: Artin-Schreier structure-sheaf comparison: transport the equal augmentation classes after choosing the prescribed target global class.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleAdditiveCech_augmentation_prescribed_class
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (J : InjectiveResolution Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (cX : Etale.ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison X.etaleAdditiveSheaf I)
    (cY : Etale.ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf J)
    (n : ℕ)
    (z : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n)
    (z' : (cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n)
    (hcoords : ∀ y : Fin (n + 1) → ι,
            cechCoordinate Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) n y
                ((cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z') =
              (show Y.Modules from SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE (hinter n y)).op
                ((SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app
                  (op (⨅ l, U (y l)))
                  (cechCoordinate X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) n y
                    ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U
                      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z))))
    (s : (additiveCechGlobal I).cycles n)
    (tα tβ : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n)
    (hα : (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tα =
      additiveCechAlpha U I n ((additiveCechGlobal I).iCycles n s))
    (hβ : (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tβ = additiveCechBeta U I n
      ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z))
    (heq : (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tα =
      (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tβ)
    (s' : (additiveCechGlobal J).cycles n)
    (hclass : cY.globalEquiv n ((additiveCechGlobal J).homologyπ n s') =
        Sheaf.H.map
          (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction _ g).homEquiv _ _).symm
            (Scheme.etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar g)) n
          (Etale.cohomologyMap g X.etaleAdditiveSheaf n
            (cX.globalEquiv n ((additiveCechGlobal I).homologyπ n s)))) :
    ∃ (tα' tβ' : (additiveCechTotal V J).cycles n),
      (additiveCechTotal V J).iCycles n tα' =
        additiveCechAlpha V J n ((additiveCechGlobal J).iCycles n s') ∧
      (additiveCechTotal V J).iCycles n tβ' = additiveCechBeta V J n
        ((cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V
          (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z') ∧
      (additiveCechTotal V J).homologyπ n tα' =
        (additiveCechTotal V J).homologyπ n tβ'
